description: If \(H_L\ne\varnothing\), universally asserted relation clauses \(\mathcal C\) have no model exactly when some finite subset of their actual ground clauses is propositionally unsatisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.finite_clause_obstruction.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  [Nonempty (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L)]
  (Γ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L α)) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseSatisfiable Γ ↔
    ∃ Δ, ↑Δ ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundClauses Γ ∧ ¬Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Sat Δ
